fun_fact: Today's words meet in Bengaluru, where a proposed 16.74-km Hebbal–Silk Board tunnel road would be blasted and excavated beneath Lalbagh Botanical Garden — passing under the Lalbagh Rock, a ~3-billion-year-old peninsular gneiss declared a National Geological Monument in 1975. Is it really worth saving a few minutes for a few cars? [Read more](https://india.mongabay.com/2025/10/the-environmental-cost-of-a-tunnel-road/)
